#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Helper script to dump an existing standard Workspace (e.g. 'Stock') so we can
mirror its structure when creating the PCB Dashboard workspace.
"""

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())

from AUTO_EXECUTE_FRAPPE_CONSOLE import execute_frappe_command


def main() -> None:
    code = """\
import frappe, json
frappe.init(site='frontend')
frappe.connect()

ws = frappe.get_doc('Workspace', 'Stock')
print('Workspace name:', ws.name)
print('Title:', ws.title)
print('Content JSON:')
print(ws.content)
print('\\nCharts table:')
print(json.dumps([{'chart_name': c.chart_name, 'label': c.label} for c in ws.charts], indent=2))
print('\\nNumber cards table:')
print(json.dumps([{'number_card_name': n.number_card_name, 'label': n.label} for n in ws.number_cards], indent=2))
"""
    execute_frappe_command(code, site="frontend", show_output=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
